headerDisplay: Configure your Ariston Aqua Water Heater (Velis / Velis Tech Dry) using your Ariston Net RemoteThermo credentials.

name.title: Water Heater Name

username.description: Email address used to log in to ://remotethermo.com and the Ariston mobile app.

password.title: Ariston Net Password

model.title: Model Name

serial_number.description: Optional serial number displayed in HomeKit accessory details.
